purpose: Noel ranking-statue defect: the statue path (Actor_ApplyStatueNPCShaderRecursive 0x4F7AC0) assigns the GPU-skinning material StatueNPC on the mere PRESENCE of a NiSkinningMeshModifier. Software-skinned meshes ship without a BONE_PALETTE, both SkinBone upload handlers (0xB9E801, 0xBCC181) bail out on a missing palette and return success, so the draw reuses whatever bone matrices the previous Char_Statue mesh left in the constant registers. These two files are the only pair in the client where the garment BODY is software-skinned.
change: NiSkinningMeshModifier USE_SOFTWARE_SKINNING (Flags&1) removed (0x0003 -> 0x0002); sync points 2 -> 1; CPU deform-output POSITION/NORMAL streams dropped and replaced by one interleaved GPU-readable vertex stream [TEXCOORD, POSITION_BP, NORMAL_BP, BLENDINDICES, BLENDWEIGHT] at stride 48 usage/access (1,18), plus a BONE_PALETTE stream usage/access (3,3); material DefaultRag2ShaderNoSkin -> DefaultRag2ShaderSkin; block count/order/refs held constant (freed NiDataStream slots rewritten as 29-byte unreferenced 0-byte stubs, not deleted); all edits by splicing.

verification.mutation_controls_caught: palette-window-base swap and palette-entry swaps detected on every converted mesh (deviation 2.4e0 - 1.4e2 world units under random transforms)

known_open_item: Root-cause analysis also proposed a binary patch at 0x4F7B27 as the more complete fix: it would cover all 104 software-skinned meshes client-wide and any future one, whereas this asset fix covers only these two files.
